items.title: File Einspruch against the 2024 income tax assessment
items.quote: Der Einspruch ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids beim Finanzamt Beispielhausen, Am Musterwall 7, 31134 Beispielhausen, schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen oder dort zur Niederschrift zu erklären.
items.computation: Letter dated and posted 27.10.2025 (Monday). Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO a letter sent by ordinary post is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting: 27.10.2025 + 4 days = 31.10.2025 (Friday). Since this is a Finanzamt, if the 4th day were a Saturday/Sunday/holiday it would move to the next working day (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO) - but 31.10.2025 is a Friday, so it stands as the delivery (Bekanntgabe) date. The one-month objection period under § 355 Abs. 1 AO / §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB starts the day after delivery (01.11.2025, day of the event not counted) and ends one month later on the day with the same number: 30.11.2025 is the last day since November has no 31st (§ 188 Abs. 3 BGB - end-of-month rule applies here because the starting reference day, 31 October, does not exist in November). 30.11.2025 is a Sunday, so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the deadline moves to the next working day, Monday 01.12.2025. No relevant public holiday intervenes.

items.quote: Die Auszahlung erfolgt in den nächsten Tagen auf das bekannte Konto.
